items.title: Storm Austen brings power cuts and travel disruption as more wind and rain forecast
items.summary: Millions remain under yellow weather warnings for wind and rain, with a second storm expected to hit Scotland and parts of northern England on Saturday.

items.title: Watch: Moment part of Brighton's historic West Pier collapses
items.summary: Footage taken during Storm Austen shows a section of the famous landmark battered by large waves and collapsing into the water.

items.title: Meghan says she was informed about 'disturbing allegations' against her father in 2018
items.summary: The Duchess of Sussex issues a statement following reports her father Thomas Markle is being investigated over child sex abuse images in the Philippines.

items.title: Meghan statement offers answers after years of questions about her relationship with father
items.summary: Today, without exactly using the word, Meghan claimed vindication.

items.title: Deadly shooting near Paris is a 'racist terrorist attack', Macron says
items.summary: One person is killed and five wounded in a series of attacks and the suspected gunman has been apprehended.

items.title: White House says Melania Trump brokers truce for Ukraine city 'on brink of disaster'
items.summary: Ukraine and Russia confirm the truce in Russian-occupied Oleshky, where residents have had to eat garden weeds to survive.

items.title: Bayern Munich manager Kompany taken to hospital after collapsing at training
items.summary: Bayern Munich manager Vincent Kompany is taken to hospital after collapsing as he watched the club's second team train on Friday.

items.title: Burnham suggests stocking up on tinned food and bottled water
items.summary: The prime ministers says unexpected events seem to be becoming more common and it was wise to prepare.
